import os
import re
from datetime import datetime
from openpyxl import load_workbook

spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/50630/1_50630_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/50630_0_102d6927/1_50630_output.xlsx"

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

def split_sentence(sentence):
    if sentence is None:
        return None, None, None
    text = str(sentence).replace("\xa0", " ")
    m = re.match(r"^\s*(.*?)\s+Added\s+(.+?)\s+Due\s+(.+?)\s*$", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    if not m:
        return None, None, None
    name = " ".join(m.group(1).split())
    added_date = " ".join(m.group(2).split())
    due_text = " ".join(m.group(3).split())
    due_date = datetime.strptime(due_text, "%d %b %Y")
    return name, added_date, due_date

# Modify only the requested answer cells C5:E6.
for row in range(5, 7):
    name, added_date, due_date = split_sentence(ws[f"A{row}"].value)
    ws[f"C{row}"] = name
    ws[f"D{row}"] = added_date
    ws[f"E{row}"] = due_date
    ws[f"E{row}"].number_format = "yyyy-mm-dd h:mm:ss"

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

import os
import re
from datetime import datetime
from openpyxl import load_workbook

def clean_spaces(value):
    return " ".join(str(value).replace("\xa0", " ").split())

def ensure_2021(date_text):
    date_text = clean_spaces(date_text)
    if not re.search(r"\b\d{4}\b", date_text):
        date_text = f"{date_text} 2021"
    return date_text

def parse_date_2021(date_text):
    date_text = ensure_2021(date_text)
    for fmt in ("%d %b %Y", "%d %B %Y"):
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(date_text, fmt)
        except ValueError:
            pass
    raise ValueError(f"Could not parse date: {date_text!r}")

def split_sentence(sentence):
    if sentence is None or str(sentence).strip() == "":
        return None, None, None
    text = str(sentence).replace("\xa0", " ")
    m = re.match(r"^\s*(.*?)\s+Added\s+(.+?)\s+Due\s+(.+?)\s*$", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    if not m:
        return None, None, None
    name = clean_spaces(m.group(1))
    added_date = ensure_2021(m.group(2))
    due_date = parse_date_2021(m.group(3))
    return name, added_date, due_date

# Modify only the requested cells: C5:E6.
for row in range(5, 7):
    name, added_date, due_date = split_sentence(ws[f"A{row}"].value)
    ws[f"C{row}"] = name
    ws[f"D{row}"] = added_date
    ws[f"E{row}"] = due_date
    ws[f"E{row}"].number_format = "yyyy-mm-dd h:mm:ss"

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
